newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-INKSTER LEADS, 14-YEAR-OLD GULBIS MISSES CUT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-INKSTER LEADS, 14-YEAR-OLD GULBIS MISSES CUT.

text.p: Fourteen-year-old Natalie Gulbis saw her great adventure come to a close at the $500,000 LPGA tournament here Friday when she carded an 84 and missed the cut with a 21-over-par total of 165 for 36 holes.

Second-rounder leader Juli Inkster, whose four-under 68 gave her a one-stroke lead over 1997 money leader Annika Sorenstam, was full of praise for the precocious Gulbis, who played her way into the field.
"I think she's a great player," Inkster said of Gublis. "(She has) a great head on her shoulders. She hits a long shot."
Sorenstam was equally excited about the youngster. "I think it's great. She's local and that's great."
Inkster was 25 strokes better than Gulbis at four-under-par 140.
Barb Mucha, Sharon Barrett and Alicia Dibos were tied at two-under 142.
